combat_progression.rationale: Strong core combat and meaningful escalation, with modest enemy variety and no distinct wave or boss structure.
evidence: src/app.js:91-126 implements enemy spawning, projectile collisions, damage, score gain, wave-dependent speed/spawn rate, and tougher two-hit enemies after wave 4.
src/game-logic.js:17-19 and tests/game-logic.test.js:17-22 define and test increasing waves; browser-evaluator.log records score 110 with enemyCount 3.

visual_design.rationale: Polished, coherent neon art direction with strong hierarchy, responsive composition, and visible animation/feedback treatment.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows the designed launch state, beacon, typography, HUD, and neon cyan/pink visual system.
desktop-after.png visibly shows the animated gameplay canvas with grid, stars, glowing ship, HUD, and leaderboard.

mobile.png visibly shows the stacked responsive layout, readable cards, directional pad, and FIRE control; src/app.js:128-143 and styles.css:20-53 implement canvas effects, glow, particles, scanlines, and responsive styling.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The implementation provides loading, empty, offline, network-error, validation, labels, focus treatment, and touch-accessible controls.
evidence: src/app.js:148-170 handles missing configuration, loading/error states, client validation, and non-blocking leaderboard failures.
index.html includes semantic labels, aria-label/aria-live/status attributes, and a screen-reader-only label; browser-evaluator.log records 7 labeled elements and no console or page errors.
styles.css:23,49,53 provides readable hidden labels, input focus styling, and narrow-screen layout behavior.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in schema applies RLS, constrained public access, database validation, and no privileged browser credential; retained live requests confirm the deployed anon read/insert path.
evidence: supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:2-30 defines name and score constraints, enables RLS, grants only select/insert, and revokes update/delete/truncate for anon and authenticated roles.
config.js contains a public anon-key configuration only, and README.md documents that no service-role key is used.
browser-evaluator.log records live Supabase GET status 200 and POST status 201 requests, with subsequent successful reads.

engineering_quality.rationale: Build, syntax-check scripts, focused tests, deterministic static packaging, and a lockfile are present; one point is withheld because retained automated tests cover only three pure-helper cases rather than UI/game integration.
evidence: package.json defines test, check, and build scripts; package-lock.json is lockfileVersion 3 with no unpinned dependencies.
build.log and build.exit-code show a successful build with exit code 0; test.log and test.exit-code show 3 passing tests and exit code 0.
src/game-logic.js separates pure validation/difficulty helpers from src/app.js, while scripts/build.mjs produces the static dist artifact.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is reproducible from the retained source, migration, build script, lockfile, and factual setup/deployment documentation.
evidence: README.md documents local setup, controls, architecture, database/security decisions, and Cloudflare/Supabase deployment steps.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql and scripts/build.mjs provide the schema and static build procedures.
source-manifest.txt lists the retained source, migration, tests, lockfile, and dist files; browser-evaluator.log and build/test logs provide factual verification artifacts.

summary: Manual subtotal: 44/46; retained automated evaluator allocation: 54 points.
